teaser.en: Snap a leaf and white milk runs out; look up and you may see its warty green fruits hanging in pairs.
teaser.sw: Vunja jani na maziwa meupe hutiririka; tazama juu na huenda ukaona matunda yake ya kijani yenye vigwaru yakining'inia wawili wawili.
teaser.dg: Gbwanyula kodza na maziya mereru ganatuluka; lola dzulu na unaweza kuona matundage ga chijani genye maugu ganalengela mairi mairi.

summary.en: *Chibombo* is a small tree with milky sap, glossy leaves, fragrant white flowers and paired, warty fruits. Digo tell it apart by its leaves and its latex.
summary.sw: *Chibombo* ni mti mdogo wenye utomvu mweupe kama maziwa, majani yanayong'aa, maua meupe yenye harufu nzuri na matunda yenye vigwaru yanayoota wawili wawili. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake na utomvu wake.
summary.dg: *Chibombo* ni muhi mdide wenye maziya, makodza ganayong'ala, maruwa mereru genye arufu nono, na matunda genye maugu ganayomera mairi mairi. Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage na maziyage.

about.en: The toad tree is a small tree with a rounded crown and glossy, dark green leaves in opposite pairs. Every part bleeds white milky latex when cut. Its fragrant white flowers are star-shaped with twisted petals. The fruits are its most noticeable feature: large, rough, warty green balls, usually in pairs, which split to show seeds in bright orange flesh. The warty skin gives the English name. Digo recognise it by its leaves and its latex.
about.sw: *Toad tree* ni mti mdogo wenye taji ya mviringo na majani yanayong'aa ya kijani kilichokolea, yaliyo jozi zinazotazamana. Kila sehemu yake hutoa utomvu mweupe kama maziwa ikikatwa. Maua yake meupe yenye harufu nzuri yana umbo la nyota na petali zilizojisokota. Matunda ndiyo sifa yake inayoonekana zaidi: mipira mikubwa ya kijani, mikwaruzu na yenye vigwaru, kwa kawaida wawili wawili, inayopasuka kuonyesha mbegu ndani ya nyama ya rangi ya chungwa angavu. Ngozi hiyo yenye vigwaru ndiyo inayoupa jina lake la Kiingereza (*toad*, chura). Wadigo huutambua kwa majani yake na utomvu wake.
about.dg: *Chibombo* ni muhi mdide wenye dzulu ra mviringo, na makodza ganayong'ala ga chijani chiru, ganayolengana mairi mairi. Chila seemu ichikatwa inalavya maziya mereru. Maruwage mereru genye arufu nono ni ga umbo ra nyota, na makodza ga ruwa ganasongoloka. Matundage ndigo ganayoonekana zaidi: ni madonge makulu ga chijani, ganayokaraza na genye maugu, mara nyinji mairi mairi, ganayoahuka kuonyesa tembe ndani ya nyama ya rangi ya chungbwa inayong'ala. Gada renye maugu ndiro rinaropha dzina ra Chingereza, *toad tree* ('muhi wa gula'). Adigo anachimanya kpwa makodzage na maziyage.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, riverine forest and thicket from Kenya south to South Africa.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani, misitu ya kando ya mito na vichaka vizito kuanzia Kenya kusini hadi Afrika Kusini.
where.dg: Chinamera matsakani ga pwani, matsakani ga kanda-kanda ya miho, na vitsakani, kula Kenya hadi kusini kpwa South Africa.

culture.en: Although its name starts with *chi-*, Pakia points out that here the prefix doesn't mean 'small': *chibombo* is a tree. A related shrub is called *chibombo ulimbo*, 'chibombo with latex'. That is *Rauvolfia mombasiana* (*mzigande*), which looks similar but has a more dangerous, poisonous latex.
culture.sw: Ingawa jina lake linaanza na *chi-*, Pakia inaeleza kuwa hapa kiambishi hicho hakimaanishi 'mdogo': *chibombo* ni mti. Kichaka kimoja kinachohusiana nao huitwa *chibombo ulimbo*, '*chibombo* chenye utomvu'. Huo ni *Rauvolfia mombasiana* (*mzigande*), unaofanana nao lakini una utomvu wenye sumu na hatari zaidi.
culture.dg: Hata kala dzinare rinaandza na *chi-*, Pakia anaonyesa kukala phapha mwandzo uho tauna mana ya 'chidide': *chibombo* ni muhi. Chitsaka cha ndugu chinaihwa *chibombo ulimbo*, '*chibombo* chenye ulimbo'. Hicho ni *Rauvolfia mombasiana* (*mzigande*), chinachohalana na *chibombo*, ela chenye ulimbo wa sumu ambao ni wa hatari zaidi.

names.en: Pakia records *chibombo* for *Tabernaemontana elegans* and lists it among the names whose meaning cannot be analysed. 'Toad tree' is a common English name for the species. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi *chibombo* kwa *Tabernaemontana elegans* na inaliorodhesha miongoni mwa majina ambayo maana yake haiwezi kuchambuliwa. '*Toad tree*' ni jina la kawaida la Kiingereza la spishi hii. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *chibombo* kpwa *Tabernaemontana elegans* na anariika kahi ya madzina gasigoweza kuelezwa manage. *Toad tree* ni dzina ra Chingereza rinarohumirwa sana kpwa aina hino. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.

reason.sw: Rauvolfia, iliyopewa jina chibombo ulimbo kutokana na mti huu
reason.dg: *Rauvolfia*, ambayo inaihwa *chibombo ulimbo* kpwa sababu ya muhi huno
